pages.text: The $(d)Flight$() Gene $(9)allows players to fly$() by double-tapping jump.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().

By default, this Gene requires the following other Genes:$(li)$(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/teleport)Teleport$(/l)$(li)$(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/step_assist)Step Assist$(/l)$(li)$(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/no_fall_damage)No Fall Damage$(/l)
